dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He really seemed to care a lot about the theater...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Once you get to know him, you'll realize that he's actually a big softie at heart. He'll even help out with furniture repair and painting the stage!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Paimon didn't think he had that in him at all!
